newsitem.title: CHINA: Bank of China lends $82 mln to auto, chemical firms.
newsitem.headline: Bank of China lends $82 mln to auto, chemical firms.

text.p: The Bank of China has granted 680 million yuan ($82 million) in loans to Jilin Chemical Industrial Group Co and First Automobile Group Co, the Financial News said on Thursday.

The bank's branch in northeastern Jilin province also loaned 380 million yuan to Jilin Chemical to be used for a new ethylene plant expected to start production in late September, the newspaper said. The plant will produce 300,000 tonnes of ethylene a year eventually.
The bank also loaned 300 million yuan to First Automobile to be used as operating capital, it said without giving further details.
By the end of August, the branch had provided 1.06 billion yuan in working capital loans to First Automobile, the newspaper said.
